summary: Implement a layered config loader (defaults < JSON file < env vars) with nested keys and type coercion.
what_tests_check: Deep merge and precedence, no mutation of DEFAULTS, unknown/nested-unknown file keys and bad files raise ConfigError, env prefix/double-underscore nesting, per-type coercion (bool words, list splitting), noisy/unknown env ignored, coercion errors name the variable, os.environ fallback.
